name: solmass
description: SolMass — a competitive Web3 arena game inspired by Agar.io, on the iDos Games host shell: sign-in and the lobby come from @idosgames/app-shell, the game and the leaderboard are modules plugged in via src/modules.ts.
//: Versions are pinned exactly: this is a seed for AI Coder projects, which build offline against a dependency allowlist baked at these versions (see scripts/pack-builder.mjs). Modules bring their own engine deps (three/phaser) when added.
//solana: @reown/appkit-adapter-solana, @solana/web3.js, @solana/wallet-adapter-base and buffer are optional peers of @idosgames/wallet that its lazy wallet entry imports; `vite build` fails without them even though no file here imports them.
//overrides: wagmi 3.7.2 imports viem/tempo/zones, which viem dropped in 2.56. Nothing here depends on viem directly, so a fresh install picks the newest 2.x and the build fails. 2.55.19 is the last version that has it — drop this once the pinned wagmi no longer needs it.
